title: The Future of Longevity with Tony Robbins

reader_summary.headline: If the placebo effect is so strong, it'd be great to understand it.
reader_summary.overview: If the placebo effect is so strong, it'd be great to understand it. Athletes are usually the first people to do this because they're like biohackers. The future is what we make it, right? No pain in my spine for the first time in 14 years.

key_points.text: Three months later, the MRI, there's absolutely nothing wrong.

key_points.text: Data plus AI plus iterations means we can finally make advances.
